title: Which Tokens, in What Order, and How Fast? A Theoretical Analysis of On-Policy Distillation Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2611.23397v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model to match a teacher model based on its own generations. When using OPD, one must choose whether to apply it at the sequence or token level and which divergence to minimize. However, despite the wide adoption of OPD in practice, the formal understanding of which OPD objective is appropriate for a given setting is limited. Toward addressing this gap, we theoretically analyze how the choice of OPD objective governs which tokens are prioritized, in what order, and how efficiently. Our analysis reveals that sequence-level OPD exhibits a future agreement bias, which myopic token-level objectives avoid. This bias induces a reverse learning order, in which sequence-level OPD first matches the teacher at later token positions, while at earlier positions it can favor tokens that are improbable under the teacher, and thus often undesirable. translated_title: 哪些Token、以何种顺序、多快？关于在线策略蒸馏目标的理论分析
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏训练学生语言模型基于其自身的生成内容来匹配教师模型。在使用OPD时，必须选择是在序列级别还是Token级别应用它，以及最小化哪种散度。然而，尽管OPD在实践中被广泛采用，关于哪种OPD目标适用于特定设置的形式化理解仍然有限。为弥补这一空白，我们从理论上分析了OPD目标的选择如何决定哪些Token被优先处理、以什么顺序以及效率如何。我们的分析揭示，序列级OPD表现出一种“未来一致性偏差”，而短视的Token级目标可以避免这种偏差。这种偏差导致了一种反向学习顺序：序列级OPD首先在较靠后的Token位置上匹配教师模型，而在较早的位置上，它可能偏好那些在教师模型下概率较低、因而通常不合意的Token。至于散度的选择，我们证明……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次从理论上剖析在线策略蒸馏目标的选择机制，揭示序列级OPD存在导致反向学习顺序的“未来一致性偏差”，而Token级目标可避免该偏差，并阐明了散度选择如何影响Token的优先级、学习顺序与收敛效率。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first theoretical analysis of on-policy distillation objectives, revealing that sequence-level OPD suffers from a future agreement bias that induces a reverse learning order while token-level objectives avoid it, and clarifying how the choice of divergence governs token prioritization, learning order, and efficiency.
